verdict.rationale: Bitwarden ships an official, fully featured CLI. Its personal API key authentication is documented as "suitable for automated workflows", which supports headless CI use, and `bw serve` exposes the vault as a local REST API. A runtime probe confirmed the CLI installs keylessly from npm and runs. Missing for 10: CI-pipeline-specific documentation (e.g., examples for non-interactive unlock and session handling in CI) and hands-on evidence of an authenticated end-to-end automated run beyond install and version output.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Bitwarden command-line interface (CLI) is a powerful, fully-featured tool for accessing and managing your vault.
Using the personal API key for CLI authentication is suitable for automated workflows
the official bw CLI installs keylessly from npm (@bitwarden/cli, registry latest 2026.8.0) and prints its version
